questions.q: Under the Sale of Goods Act, a stipulation in a contract of sale that is fundamental to the main purpose of the contract, the breach of which gives the buyer the right to reject the goods and repudiate the contract, is called a...
questions.explain: A **condition** is a vital term going to the root of a contract. Breach of a condition allows the injured party to reject the goods and terminate the contract. A *warranty* is less important; its breach only allows the injured party to sue for damages, but not to reject the goods.
